html:
To experience an overnight cruise on Ha Long Bay, visitors should choose the 5-star Ambassador boat, with 46 exquisitely designed cabins. Sitting on the boat, visitors can fully admire the beauty of Ha Long Bay.

In addition, the boat also has a luxury restaurant, an outdoor Jacuzzi, 2 bars and spa… along with modern facilities, and many unique games. Join Vietlook to experience the Ha Long cruise to experience the most interesting things, which will bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

At Ambassador Cruise, visitors will experience luxurious rooms such as:

Deluxe

Located on the 1st floor of the cruise, the room is 32 m2 wide, this is the perfect choice for visitors, with luxury and modernity, the room has a balcony overlooking the bay, it can be said that the experience of vacationing in Ha Long on the Ambassador cruise in the Deluxe room will bring visitors a complete vacation with absolute satisfaction.

Premium

The room is 32 m2 wide, with full amenities, the room is located on the 2nd and 4th floors of the cruise, the spacious room from here visitors can see the whole view of the bay, and there are Smart TV entertainment areas, the most beautiful is watching the scene when the sunrise or sunset falls on the sea, leaving a beautiful scene is the most memorable moment for travelers when coming to Ha Long and experiencing the overnight cruise.

Suite

Located on the 2nd floor of the stern of the cruise ship, the Suite room has a private, spacious, relaxing space, and full amenities. The experience of staying in the room also allows guests to take a private bath and enjoy the panoramic view of the bay. Therefore, the experience of staying in the Suite will be a perfect experience on the 5-star Ha Long cruise ship.

Captain Suite

Located on the 2nd floor of the bow of the cruise ship, where guests can admire the entire beauty of the bay, giving guests the most enjoyable vacation in Ha Long.

Presidential Suite

This is one of the most beautiful rooms on the cruise ship. From the room, guests can fully admire the beauty of the bay. The room is specially cared for throughout the vacation. The room has a private butler, which is the only service available for the presidential suite on the cruise ship.

Experience overnight on a cruise, visitors can also experience Asian and European cuisine, with rich and diverse dishes prepared by talented chefs, besides, visitors can also experience the infinity pool, experience the unique glass bridge.

In addition, experiencing Ha Long cruise, visitors can also experience swimming, mountain climbing, kayaking, visiting caves, … and enjoy delicious dishes right on the cruise.
